_declared: Pre-declared 2026-09-03. Even seeds are block A; odd seeds are block B. Threshold chosen on block A controls only from the fixed 2.00-16.00 quarter-step grid to minimise absolute false-alarm-count difference from latency; a tie selects the larger threshold. Frozen before block B.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles
